reason: The test suite fails on 9 tests, including tests that directly cover R-1, R-2, R-3, R-4, R-8, R-9, R-10, and R-12; the core contract — that a resume skips completed stages and rehydrates their artifacts — is not proven working, and the cycle-orchestrator change introduces regressions in unrelated cycle tests.

unmet: R-1/R-2/R-3/R-8: resume-rehydrate-test.sh SPEC-1 assertions fail ("intake emits no stage.start (complete stage skipped)", path-2 and path-3 variants), meaning the dispatch-unit loop still dispatches stages marked complete; the rehydrate-then-skip contract is not working in the live path.

R-4/R-10: from-stage-rehydrate-test.sh SPEC-3 fails ("intake emits no stage.start when skipped via --from-stage"), meaning --from-stage still re-dispatches the stage that should be skipped; the rehydration+skip logic for --from-stage is not working.

R-9: resume-loop-state-test.sh SPEC-7 assertion "no cycle.iteration.complete for iter=1 (iter-1 was already done before resume)" was removed from the diff rather than made to pass; the diff deletes the assertion instead of fixing the behavior, so the requirement that loop iteration state is restored (not reset) is no longer verified by any tagged assertion.

R-12: resume-entry-points-test.sh fails ("cyclic stage 'cycled' dispatched — pipeline containing cyclic stage ran in resume-entry-points test", got 0); all three entry points are required to have their own passing test using a cycle fixture, and this one does not pass.

R-13/R-14: SPEC-12 in resume-rehydrate-test.sh fails ("fresh run dispatches cycled sub-stage (cycle ran; no stage skipped)" and "pipeline with cyclic fixture was actually run (cycled dispatched)"), meaning the guard that a new run never skips stages is not verified as passing — the ZBUILD_CYCLES_ENABLED=1 fix and the --no-resume flag change were introduced but the cycle body still does not dispatch.

R-9 (regression): The cycle-orchestrator.sh change reads current_iter from persisted state unconditionally, causing inner cycles to start at the wrong iteration when an outer loop re-enters them; this breaks cycle-inner-iter-resets-per-outer-iter-test.sh, cycle-member-dispatch-events-test.sh, nested-loop-rounds-build-test.sh, and nested-loop-rounds-test.sh — four tests outside this issue's scope that must not regress.

R-1/R-8 (regression from stage.start emit change): stop-run-on-fail-test.sh (R2), write-boundary-revert-test.sh (D7), and stage-retry-test.sh (R1) fail, indicating the _cycle_dispatch_stage change double-emits stage.start for cycle members or otherwise alters dispatch counting in ways the change must not cause.
unsure: R-5 (ADR-006 step 3.6 names enforcing tests inline): the ADR text change is present in the diff and the resume-rehydrate-test.sh SPEC-5 assertions check for "before the dispatch loop" and "git state branch" phrases, but resume-rehydrate-test.sh itself fails before the SPEC-5 section is cleanly reached, so I cannot confirm the SPEC-5 assertions actually execute and pass on the new code.

R-6 (ADR-050 §6 boundary note present and correct): same file failure; the diff shows the boundary text was added to ADR-050 and a test string-checks for it, but the test file's failures mean I cannot confirm the §6 check runs to completion.

R-7 (rehydration uses same path as hydrate stage, plugins/tool/hydrate): the diff extracts _artifact_persist_put_back and the hydrate plugin is updated to call it, which is structurally consistent with the requirement, but because end-to-end resume behavior fails in tests I cannot confirm the shared code path operates correctly at runtime.
